column8:
 The manager of the company is endowed with the powers to
run and conduct the assets and business of the Company
within the limits of the objects of the Company.
 All powers that are not specifically provided by the law or the
articles of association to be the general meeting’s shall fall
within the competence of the manager.
column12:
The Articles of
Association dated
17/7/2002 do not
expressly make
provision for the
borrowing powers of
the manager

column8:
 The Articles are silent on the issue of borrowing powers
therefore the Commercial Law Act of Mozambique applies.

 The directors may borrow for the company the supplies it
needs and the terms and conditions of the borrowing should
be established by the General Assembly.
